'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Mike Damboise DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Damboise]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Damboise]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
